title: Vibrant Yeasty Venezuelan Chicken Empanadas
description: A traditional Venezuelan dish featuring chicken and mirepoix filling wrapped in a yeasty empanada dough, perfect for a post-workout meal
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour and yeast to make the empanada dough.
Gradually add olive oil and warm water to the dough mixture and knead for 5 minutes.
Let the dough rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
In a separate pan, heat olive oil and saute the diced onion, carrot, and celery until tender.
Add the chicken breast to the pan and cook until browned.
Add orange juice, salt, and pepper to the pan and stir to combine.
Divide the empanada dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Roll out each ball of dough into a thin circle and place a spoonful of the chicken filling in the center.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape and press the edges together to seal.
Bake the empanadas in a preheated oven at 375 degrees for 20 minutes.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
